equation: logit P(scatter) = b0 + b1*log(nMR) + b2*KA + b3*GA

variables.nMR: number of merged changes touching the feature
variables.KA: number of distinct authors on the feature
variables.GA: author concentration (normalized entropy of author shares; 1 = single author)

scatter.front: feature touches >= 2 distinct pages (layered crossing page->api->comp is normative, not scatter)

provenance.training: 19 repositories, 3,010 feature units (internal business systems and elite OSS)
provenance.out_of_sample: held-out complete microservice system (74 repositories, 2,882 feature units): frozen-coefficient transfer AUC median 0.586 vs local refit 0.592; Java business repos 0.60-0.85, front-end repos ~0.51 (local recalibration required before enabling thresholds)
provenance.guardrail_replay: 26 repositories, 1,125 features, per-merge replay with pre-event information only, tau=0.38: 164 flags in 10 months; flagged features later heavily scattered (N1>=6) 0.81 vs unflagged 0.43 (lift 1.88; Phi top-tercile lift 1.64) - correlational evidence
provenance.paper_ref: USCM-CC paper: Sections 3.10 (decision view, R1'-R3'), 9.4 item five (vi)-(vii)

boundary: Directions, rankings, probabilities and budget alarms only. No absolute cost prediction; no feature-level defect prediction (tested null); all thresholds require monthly local recalibration.
